messages:
Lina (partnerships): Heads-up: EdgeHub's connector is sending minutely device pulses but marketplace expects hourly aggregates. Need reconciliation plan + announcement timing.
Mike (eng): Noted. Do we map device pulses -> hour buckets at ingestion or ask partner to change?
Tara (partner-success): EdgeHub can emit hourly on new firmware but only in ~2 weeks. They can send both formats for a rolling week as a transition.
Kevin (billing): Billing needs SKU mapping and timezone handling. Are pulses in UTC or local device time?
Mike (eng): They currently send local device time; tz field is sometimes missing. We should canonicalize to UTC on ingest and store original tz if present.
Olga (eng-infra): Agreed. Also add de-dupe + idempotency: key = <device_id>-<hour>-<seq>. Suggest signature header validation too. Example payload sample: 
```json
{"device_id":"abc123","ts":"2026-04-01T12:34:00Z","usage":1,"sig":"sha256=..."}
```
Tara (partner-success): EdgeHub will add X-EH-Signature using HMAC-SHA256; they will rotate keys monthly.
Lina (partnerships): Proposed plan: 1) Add ingest shim to accept minutely pulses and rollup to hourly (canonicalize TZ). 2) Add reconciliation job to compare partner hourly vs our rollups and auto-create credits for discrepancies over threshold. 3) Staging canary on namespace 'edgehub-sandbox' with 10% traffic. 4) Post-results, coordinate partner portal announcement + joint go-live date.
Mike (eng): For the reconciliation job: daily diff, tolerant threshold 0.5% auto, manual review >1%. We'll surface per-SKU and per-region deltas.
Kevin (billing): Sounds good. Need clear entitlements mapping: EdgeHub SKU 'EH-GP-HOUR' -> Redwood plan 'marketplace-pro-hourly'. Also define how negative deltas are credited.
Tara (partner-success): I'll own the SKU mapping doc and request signed CSV from EdgeHub PM. ETA 4 days.
Olga (eng-infra): Monitoring: create metrics marketplace.ingest.rollup_lag and reconciliation.diff_pct. Ops-bot, please schedule an alert when diff_pct > 2% sustained for 6h.
ops-bot: Alert rule created: marketplace.reconciliation.diff_pct > 2.0 for 6h -> paging to #oncall-ingest.
Lina (partnerships): Can we soft-launch with subset of customers (10% traffic) for 48h to validate end-to-end?
Mike (eng): Yes — we can route EdgeHub traffic to 'dedicated-rollup-canary' pool and add sampling flags.
Tara (partner-success): EdgeHub requests we freeze their firmware rollout until the canary passes; they prefer no user-facing billing changes during canary.
Kevin (billing): Also need a backfill plan for the last 7 days. Estimate rerun for 10M devices ~2h on batch cluster. Prefer schedule during low usage window.
Olga (eng-infra): I'll add an Airflow DAG edgehub_hourly_backfill_v1 and include runbook steps: pre-checks, idempotent re-ingest, post-diff report. Example diff query: 
```sql
SELECT hour, SUM(our_usage) AS our_usage, SUM(partner_usage) AS partner_usage, 
       (SUM(partner_usage)-SUM(our_usage))/NULLIF(SUM(partner_usage),0) AS pct_diff
FROM edgehub_hourly_rollup JOIN edgehub_partner_hourly USING(hour)
GROUP BY hour
ORDER BY hour DESC
LIMIT 48;
```
Lina (partnerships): Next steps summary: Tara -> deliver SKU CSV + key rotation schedule; Mike -> ship ingest shim + canary routing; Olga -> create metrics, DAG, and runbook; Kevin -> finalize credit policy and entitlement mapping. Check-in: Wed 10am PT.
Mike (eng): I'll open PR for shim and include unit tests + e2e with sandbox webhooks.
Tara (partner-success): EdgeHub PM will provide sample payloads and key for sandbox tonight.
Kevin (billing): I'll draft credit rules: auto-credit when partner_usage > our_usage by >1% after reconciliation window; manual approvals for other cases.
Olga (eng-infra): I'll add dashboards per-region and per-SKU. Alerting note: also track rollup_lag > 600s to catch ingestion delays.
Lina (partnerships): Thanks team. If canary shows >1% consistent delta we pause and investigate. Otherwise, target full switch after 48h. :thumbsup:
Mike (eng): ACK. I'll post the PR link in this thread when ready.
Tara (partner-success): Thanks — will coordinate announcement timing with marketing after check-in.
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: check-in Wed 10:00 PT (automated).
